proposed_changes: Gate both model upload workflows behind an explicit confirm_external_change=YES input; validate a strict model-name slug using an environment variable, quote shell paths and disable checkout credential persistence.
Make destructive Hugging Face administration inert pending target-specific migration review.
Require explicit per-run confirmation for factory restart.
Remove push-triggered deployment paths for the self-hosted brain and A2A Worker; retain only manually confirmed deployments.
Disable the unverified multi-platform task allocator and remove provider-token access.
Disable Capability 9 data contradiction resolution until provider authentication, data classification, provenance and review are implemented.
Add regression checks to the already CI-listed tests/test_external_deploys_require_confirmation.py; do not modify ci.yml, avoiding overlap with fresh-main PRs #1555 and #1557.
limitations: A YES workflow input is a per-run confirmation gate, not a substitute for a GitHub Environment with required reviewers or a separately verified approval policy.
No external deployment, model upload, restart, repository deletion, provider call or secret access was performed.
Existing credentials were not read or tested.
The scripts/data_contradiction_resolver.py source remains in the repository; its workflow is inert in the proposal.
